entries.reason: Realtime fog splits density/velocity, optical profile, derived caches and art so each mutable fact has one writer.
entries.state: FogDensityField and MacFluidGrid own media; FogProfile owns optical constants; BeerLightCache is a derived cache; ContinuousArtParams are presentation-only.
entries.authoritative_owner: FogSystem orchestrates writes; ContinuousArt never writes density, velocity, extinction or transmittance.
entries.projections: Froxel AtmosphereVolume, BeerLightCache, FogRayResult and ContinuousArtOutput are invalidatable projections of the density/optics owners.

entries.reason: FogSystem is a domain orchestrator, not an ECS view walker; this contract records its lattice access, injected time and deferred cache invalidation.
entries.entity_scope: MAC lattice cells and analytic FogSolidProxy records owned by FogSystem; no ECS entity traversal
entries.view: cell-centered density plus face-centered MAC velocity; interactor rasterization completes before advection
entries.read_set: FogDensityField, FogProfile, SceneWind targets, FogSolidProxy geometry and AtmosphereVolume froxel dimensions
entries.write_set: MAC velocity/pressure/density, FogDensityField bands, BeerLightCache and AtmosphereVolume media during inject/integrate
entries.structural_changes: none while marching or integrating; domain resize and proxy replacement are explicit caller-owned Result operations
entries.events: CFL reports and cache version bumps after a successful step; art stylize emits no simulation events
entries.services: injected wall-clock dt accumulated into a fixed substep, named dust seed, and borrowed AtmosphereVolume for display mapping
entries.phase: simulation step before rendering; froxel inject/integrate and ContinuousArt run after physics transport

entries.reason: Renderable ECS traversal is the graphics presentation system and must state read-only scene authority.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Current ECS Renderable2D/Renderable3D views and the Graphics backend.
entries.view: Generation-checked ECS renderable views collected for one render pass.
entries.read_set: Renderable components, transform projections, material/texture handles and graphics frame state.
entries.write_set: Graphics command buffers/batches only; gameplay ECS state is not mutated by render traversal.
entries.structural_changes: No ECS structural mutation during render traversal.
entries.events: Render submission and presentation side effects stay inside Graphics; no gameplay events emitted.
entries.services: Borrowed Graphics backend and resource factory for the duration of the call.
entries.phase: Render phase after simulation state is stable.

entries.reason: Authored corner attributes and density texture have explicit source schemas and independent immutable ownership.
entries.schema: eve.sky-wisps/7 manifest and eve.sky-mesh/1 geometry; explicit texture dimensions and linear or sRGB R8/RGBA8 source encoding; version 5 validates daylight coefficients and both owned star textures; version 6 adds optical tints and bounded explicit RGBA8/RGBA16F mip chains; version 7 adds lunar surface, phase, glow and two owned linear RGBA16F mip chains.
entries.migration: Version 1 migrates to neutral parent contrast and unscaled physical sky; version 2 requires contrast controls and enables authored celestial scaling. Versions 1/2 disable the disk; version 3 adds explicit solar radiance, radius, softness and reflection scaling. Versions 1/2/3 use constant disk color; version 4 requires twelve ordered RGB elevation curve keys with constant endpoint extrapolation and unweighted cubic interpolation. Versions 1 through 5 retain static optical coefficients; version 6 requires authored optical colors and explicit mip counts. Versions 1 through 6 disable the lunar surface; version 7 requires lunar coefficients and color/normal resources. Other versions rejected.
entries.unknown_fields: Reject unknown or missing fields, wrong shapes, unsupported layout, invalid counts, nonfinite values and resource sizes.
entries.restore_atomicity: Load builds owned immutable candidates; GPU preparation validates material semantics and copies data before any contributor is published. Existing runtime state is untouched on failure.

entries.reason: Six weighted photographic Gaussian scales reuse the existing owned HDR bloom resources without replacing older filters.
entries.contract: Graphics-owned targets and copied settings; render-thread builds preserve the previous canvas. GaussianPyramid adds normalized weighted scales; existing filter defaults remain unchanged.
entries.providers: Shared C++ orchestration with GLSL/SPIR-V and WGSL shader implementations. Runtime validation is required separately for each enabled provider.
entries.shared_contract_tests: Constant HDR input checks per-channel weighted DC response and edge behavior; threshold suppression and invalid enum/settings retain explicit outcomes.
entries.failure_injection: Invalid settings reject before mutation; target and shader allocation failures follow existing Bloom exceptions without silently selecting another filter.

module_interface.capability_in: Existing Graphics texture, shader and Canvas provider.
module_interface.capability_out: Existing Bloom build/apply linear HDR textures.
module_interface.ecs_links: None. Graphics owns resources; Bloom owns copied filter settings.
module_interface.script_bindings: Existing setBloomFilter/getBloomFilter add gaussianPyramid, preserving Result validation.
module_interface.tool_protocol: No new endpoint or persistent format.
module_interface.connection: Direct render-thread calls; numeric phase uniforms on the GPU; no registry lookup or callbacks.

entries.reason: Explicit filmic presentation preserves the existing default and the linear HDR capture boundary.
entries.contract: Graphics owns one render-thread display mode; None, Aces and Filmic select final presentation only. Aces remains the default; independent cosine-fourth photographic vignette defaults to zero and affects presentation before tone mapping; HDR capture stays linear.
entries.providers: Vulkan implements all three modes and photographic vignette. Other providers retain their existing mode and zero vignette, returning Unsupported for unavailable changes.
entries.shared_contract_tests: Invalid native/script modes preserve state; Vulkan filmic GPU fixtures check neutral middle grey, black, highlights and distinct prior modes. The script test's alternate-provider branch requires Unsupported.
entries.failure_injection: Unknown enum and script string reject mutation; no resources, callbacks or partial publication are introduced by mode changes.

module_interface.capability_in: Existing Graphics provider; explicit typed mode or validated script string.
module_interface.capability_out: Existing scene resolve applies the selected display transform.
module_interface.ecs_links: None; mode lifetime is bounded by Graphics and has no borrowed inputs.
module_interface.script_bindings: setSceneToneMapping and setScenePhotographicVignette return canonical Result; corresponding getters expose current owned values.
module_interface.tool_protocol: No new endpoint or persistent format.
module_interface.hard_dependencies: Existing graphics pipeline and shader compiler; no new module or dependency.
module_interface.connection: Direct infrequent setting, render-thread read during final resolve; no registry lookup or callbacks.

entries.reason: Independent HDR atmospheric rendering reuses resource-program transactions and existing main-view/capture contributors.
entries.contract: Prepared immutable coefficients and transmission/multiple-scattering lookup tables feed a physically integrated HDR pass. No visual-parity claim until all remaining UDS stages are implemented and compared. Optional authored wisps copy corner attributes and an explicit sampled texture during preparation; atmosphere and wisps draw in fixed order with identical fog composition through the same callback. A checked view-preparation phase generates a 192x104 sky-view texture before opening the destination; identical camera/light blocks reuse it. Main and capture draws consume the same cache sequentially. Solar lighting and normalized authored-wisps phase publish atomically; validation failure leaves both unchanged. Cloud phase never invalidates the atmosphere-only view LUT.
entries.providers: Vulkan resource program implementation; other backends explicitly Unsupported.
entries.shared_contract_tests: SkyAtmospherePass captures radiance, tests energy scaling and removal; alternate backend branch requires Unsupported.
entries.failure_injection: Invalid coefficients and light energy reject publication; provider-first retirement returns StaleHandle and destructor detaches callbacks. View-preparation tests cover empty provider set, injected failure, recursive dispatch rejection and detachment.

module_interface.capability_in: Borrowed Graphics guarded by its existing weak resource lifetime. Optional SkyWispsLayer spans are synchronous borrowed upload inputs; no input pointer survives preparation.
module_interface.capability_out: Prepared pass and existing RenderSystem3D contributor tokens.
module_interface.ecs_links: No new ECS components or entity links; callbacks borrow camera snapshots during invocation only.
module_interface.script_bindings: Not exposed yet; C++ path only.
module_interface.tool_protocol: SkyWispsAsset reads eve.sky-wisps/1 through /7 and eve.sky-mesh/1 through existing prepared VFS snapshots. Import is separate from GPU preparation. SkyWispsAsset::generate(seed) creates immutable procedural-v1 resources without filesystem access; no simulation RNG or callbacks.
module_interface.hard_dependencies: Existing graphics/common dependencies only; no new module.
module_interface.connection: Infrequent atomic preparation, frequent fixed-block updates; known provider and owner-thread callbacks. ViewPreparation is a graphics-internal one-to-many synchronous ordered phase: providers are registered outside dispatch, callbacks return Result, first failure cancels the destination; no string lookup or new cross-module service.

entries.reason: Sky source volumes and HDR LUTs use the existing transactional mesh-resource boundary without a second resource registry.
entries.contract: Packed volume mips shrink XYZ; linear HDR samples retain source precision. Validation or upload failure preserves the previously published shader resources.
entries.providers: Vulkan implements 3D and HDR sampled images. The existing base/WebGPU resource-program boundary returns explicit Unsupported without publication.
entries.shared_contract_tests: SkyTextureResources checks backend-independent packing. SkyTextureGpu checks Vulkan sampling or explicit provider absence; WebGPU rejects this resource-program capability.
entries.failure_injection: Truncated payloads, volume/array mismatches, unsupported compression and oversize dimensions are rejected. Failed GPU replacement preserves the committed shader handle and rendered samples.

module_interface.capability_in: Existing Graphics, Vulkan device and optional SPIR-V validation provider; no new capability registry.
module_interface.capability_out: Existing replaceMeshShaderResources accepts additional typed formats and volume dimension.
module_interface.ecs_links: No new ECS data or cross-frame identity. Shader owns immutable GPU images; Graphics retirement releases them.
module_interface.script_bindings: Existing file-resource adapter accepts 3d, depth, wrapW and three HDR/UNORM formats; invalid input returns Result unchanged.
module_interface.tool_protocol: No new runtime tool protocol or persistent format.
module_interface.hard_dependencies: Unchanged graphics dependencies; same resource validation and Vulkan implementation TUs.
module_interface.connection: One synchronous preparation caller, infrequent resource upload, known provider, atomic replacement. Direct existing interface call.
module_interface.trim_claim: No new L2/L3/L4 trim claim. Runtime-3d remains the host integration profile.

entries.reason: Checked ordered view-resource preparation before opening main or capture render targets.
entries.contract: No providers is success. Registered callbacks run synchronously before target opening; first failure cancels the view. Detachment removes future invocations. Recursive dispatch and mutation during dispatch are forbidden.
entries.providers: Backend-independent phase; the sky provider explicitly requires Vulkan resource programs.
entries.shared_contract_tests: SkyViewPreparation exercises dispatch, failure, reentrancy, removal and actual offscreen ordering.
entries.failure_injection: Empty callback rejected; injected provider failure prevents later providers and recursive dispatch returns failure.

module_interface.capability_in: Graphics and camera snapshots borrowed only through invocation.
module_interface.capability_out: Result-returning registration and checked preparation phase; token-based removal.
module_interface.ecs_links: No new ECS components or entity links; callbacks borrow camera snapshots during invocation only.
module_interface.hard_dependencies: Existing graphics/common dependencies only; no new module.
module_interface.connection: One-to-many graphics-thread synchronous phase; known registrants, ordered resource readiness, no per-frame string lookup.

entries.reason: Resource factory owns cached file textures and samplers; groom mutations prepare once and reuse the same backend mesh.

provides.absent_behavior: Default newSharedTexture and loadTexture report Unsupported; no implicit uncached allocation.

requires.fallback: Borrowed only during upload; invalid input returns InvalidArgument.

entries.thread_affinity: Graphics owner thread; upload and material preparation do not invoke callbacks.

trim.absent_profile: No new trim claim: graphics is required by this visual project; reduced backend profiles require separate builds.

cost_notes.why: ResultRef borrows backend cache ownership; upload cost is paid on first model preparation, never in a frame loop.
Prepare once, then explicit setFoliageWindTime updates per frame.
Canonical ready load returns ResultRef borrowing the graphics cache; a miss completes preparation, resident hits do not probe the source or upload.
Legacy facade: first use prepares pixels; resident cache hits do not probe files or upload. Reload is explicit.
Equal state does no backend work; edits publish before consuming draws, with one Vulkan descriptor drain per changed batch.
Every simulation dt executes; derived geometry publishes once in view preparation or explicit draw. Mesh identity/capacity is reused.
